SCHOOL ROOMS

The rooms of the school.

Eight rooms to wander into — a library to read in, a garden to grow in, a playground to run in, a music room to play in, an art room to make in, a clubs room to join, a cafeteria to taste and a hall to celebrate in. Each room keeps its own cards, its own art and its own way of playing: pick a door.

SCHOOL ROOM

School Library

The school bookshelf. Real picture books to read online — organized by age and category, every page turn on its own reader.

Visit the School Library ↗SCHOOL ROOM

School Garden

Real garden lessons and collections: bugs and insects, garden animals and friends, garden flowers, and the things you find outside.

Visit the School Garden ↗SCHOOL ROOM

Playground

Action words, playground equipment and the five manners that make play kind — thirty-two cards, from balance and swing to share and take turns.

Visit the Playground ↗SCHOOL ROOM

Music Room

Instruments, music words and the people who make music — fifty-three cards to print, from accordion to xylophone, with the beat and volume words on the wall.

Visit the Music Room ↗SCHOOL ROOM

Art Room

Twenty-seven art-activity cards for little hands: crayons, paint, clay and scissors — every card prints its own make-it activity, from draw a picture with shapes to cut out simple shapes.

Visit the Art Room ↗SCHOOL ROOM

Clubs

Forty-five after-school clubs for ages 3–12: art, music and baking for the youngest members, then chess, coding and fencing for ages 6 and up — every card prints the two skills its club trains.

Join the Clubs ↗SCHOOL ROOM

Cafeteria

Sixty-two lunch-tray foods for ages 2–5: fruits, mains, breakfasts, drinks and snacks — every card prints its own pointing, counting or matching activity, and every food has a lesson and a printable twin.

Visit the Cafeteria ↗SCHOOL ROOM

The School Hall

Where the whole school celebrates: the calendar of special days — Halloween, Thanksgiving, Christmas, Valentine’s Day and Eid, the next one first — each with its own kid-sized page and printable cards.

Visit the School Hall ↗

Every room’s cards and pages live inside the rooms themselves — the classes and lessons keep their own shelves on the Learning Path, the printable card library sits at Flashcards, and the book reader lives in the Library.
